problem_statement: Router-ID membership lookups in the MLE router-id mask and the router table report an ID as allocated when the ID is outside the valid router-ID range. A caller asking whether a router ID (0..255) is allocated on a freshly cleared mask / empty router table can get a positive answer for IDs that are larger than the maximum valid router ID, because the lookup indexes its backing storage by the raw ID without validating that the ID is in range. An out-of-range router ID must never be reported as allocated; it must always be reported as not allocated.
